# stream sensor

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:streamSensor`](gmeow-streamSensor.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/streamSensor>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The specific sensor or agent producing the stream. Non-functional: multiple sensors may contribute to one stream, and competing sensor claims coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the specific sensor or agent that reads the samples of a stream — the device doing the measuring.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the platform that carries the sensor ([`gmeow:streamPlatform`](gmeow-streamPlatform.md)) or the tracked subject ([`gmeow:streamOf`](gmeow-streamOf.md)); and avoid forcing one sensor — several may contribute, so it stays non-functional.

### How to use

- Bind the reading sensor agent; when multiple sensors fuse into one stream, assert each with [`gmeow:streamSensor`](gmeow-streamSensor.md) and let competing sensor claims coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### Examples

- ex:roverTrack [`gmeow:streamSensor`](gmeow-streamSensor.md) ex:gnssReceiver.
